line: Leave a generous tip and a kind word with it.
paragraph: Warren Buffett, the investor who runs the Berkshire Hathaway company, marked Thanksgiving with a large gift. He converted thousands of his company shares into a charitable donation worth about $5.5 billion. In an annual message, he wrote that the most powerful returns in life are not measured by stock prices. He noted that kindness is priceless. There is a quiet peace in giving.
